title: Frontiers: A Simple Forward Difference-in-Differences Method
eligible_reason: Methods paper proposing Forward DiD (data-driven selection of control units for a single treated unit) with inference theory. The package illustrates it on the Hsiao-Ching-Wan Hong Kong GDP panel (one treated unit, one date). No TWFE panel with staggered binary adoption.
design_notes: MATLAB and R functions (FDID_Matlab.m, Fun_FDID.R). Reports FDID ATT and a conventional DID ATT for the single treated unit.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: single treated unit, single date; forward DiD control selection (synthetic-control-like)

data_files: GDP.csv (illustrative public dataset, not the paper's application)
data_files_note: ForwardDID_Readme.txt: the dataset used in the paper is proprietary; code is released with a public GDP dataset instead.
data_provenance_note: Paper's own data proprietary and not shipped; only an illustrative public dataset.
screener_notes: Software: MATLAB and R. Code scan found no regression commands (prescore 0).
